name: Frugality
overview: Scripture illustrates frugality as wise and purposeful provision, exemplified by Joseph's careful gathering and storage of abundant grain during seven years of plenty to prepare for coming famine, ensuring no lack during years of scarcity. Similarly, the Israelites' gathering of manna was measured and sufficient, with each person collecting according to their need so that none was wasted or deficient. These examples highlight frugality as stewardship of God's resources, balancing abundance with prudent restraint in reliance on His provision.
